shape: a small everyday annoyance someone causes now, seen from the day it stops

slides.text: you complain about her television on volume forty-five, but one day you'll sit on that sofa with [[nothing to turn down]].

caption:
my grandma still keeps the quiz show loud enough to shake the mantelpiece.
you have to shout across the rug just to ask where the biscuits are.
send this to your sister who always reaches for the remote control.

#grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
alt: a short text post about leaving a grandparent's loud television alone, beside a small green donkey listening closely.
